# Module inventory

<!-- Generated by tests/module_inventory.rs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every module `src/lib.rs` exports, and whether anything outside that module's own files
names it. Regenerate with:

```bash
GLAEDA_WRITE_MODULE_INVENTORY=1 cargo test --locked --test module_inventory
```

`tests/module_inventory.rs` fails when this document disagrees with the tree, so the counts
below are always those of the commit that contains them. It replaces the hand-maintained
capability map retired to
[`history/IMPLEMENTATION_MAP.md`](history/IMPLEMENTATION_MAP.md), which drifted to
describing 91 of 200 exports.

This is an inventory. It grants no authority to refactor, delete, rename, expose, or call a
module, and it makes no claim that a module *should* be composed or retired. Product track
and classification live in [`ROADMAP.md`](ROADMAP.md) and the owning contract documents.

## Reach

| reach | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `binary` | reachable from `src/main.rs` or `src/bin/*.rs` through non-test library code |
| `library` | named by other non-test library code; no binary path reaches it |
| `tests` | named only by `tests/` or by `#[cfg(test)]` code in another module |
| `none` | named by no file outside its own definition |

Resolution is textual and therefore `cfg`-blind: a Linux-gated consumer counts on every
platform, so these numbers are identical on an Apple-silicon control plane and the
`ubuntu-24.04` Verify runner. `src/lib.rs` is not a consumer; the export is the thing
being measured.

## Totals

- Exported modules: **203**
- Reach: **96 binary**, **62 library**, **11 tests**, **34 none**
- Gate: at most 34 exports may have reach `none` (`UNREFERENCED_EXPORT_CEILING`)

## Exports with no consumer

These are reviewed kernels that no binary, library module, test, bench, or example names.
The repository builds kernels first and defers composition on purpose, so this list is the
standing record of that deferral, not a defect list. Compose one, retire it through
[`history/RETIRED_FEATURE_ISLANDS.md`](history/RETIRED_FEATURE_ISLANDS.md), or leave it and
let the gate hold the line.
